svg.title: 16. Crater city — experimental Bellweather map
svg.desc: Bellweather sits on the crater floor. Four breaks in the rim connect the inner neighborhoods to an outer circuit. Only printed routes define adjacency for every effect. District footprints and route intersections create no additional links. Three regions hold eighteen Support each; Bellweather holds three separately.
svg.text: Urban 18 Support / 9 votes Mixed 18 / 9 Outlying 18 / 9 Bellweather 3 separate
Only printed routes create adjacency. Every route joins its two endpoint districts for all effects.
Nearby footprints are not adjacent. Double-railed spans mark bridges, gates, passes, or viaducts.
Experimental concept · 26 connections · No dead ends · District elections remain local
